data.command_snapshot: {"command":"cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin adashi-mcp; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $exe = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'src-tauri\\target\\debug\\adashi-mcp.exe'; $psi = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new($exe); $psi.WorkingDirectory = (Get-Location).Path; $psi.UseShellExecute = $false; $psi.RedirectStandardInput = $true; $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true; $psi.RedirectStandardError = $true; $p = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($psi); $p.StandardInput.AutoFlush = $true; $p.StandardInput.WriteLine('{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"method\":\"initialize\",\"params\":{\"protocolVersion\":\"2024-11-05\",\"capabilities\":{},\"clientInfo\":{\"name\":\"adashi-qa\",\"version\":\"1\"}}}'); Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; if (!$p.HasExited) { $p.Kill() }; $out = $p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd(); $err = $p.StandardError.ReadToEnd(); if ($out -notmatch 'protocolVersion' -or $out -notmatch '\"tools\"') { Write-Output $out; Write-Error (\"MCP initialize smoke failed. stderr: \" + $err); exit 1 }; Write-Output 'MCP stdio initialize smoke passed';","designSpecificationLinks":[{"designExternalId":"5","id":6,"qaJobId":5,"sortOrder":0,"targetType":"element","title":"Adashi MCP Server"},{"designExternalId":"mcp-qa-api","id":7,"qaJobId":5,"sortOrder":1,"targetType":"element","title":"QA MCP API"},{"designExternalId":"QAMCPSequence","id":8,"qaJobId":5,"sortOrder":2,"targetType":"uml","title":"QA MCP Query and Run Sequence"}],"enabled":true,"name":"MCP stdio initialize smoke","shell":"powershell","tags":["mcp","smoke","stdio"],"taskLinks":[],"timeoutSeconds":90,"workingDirectory":""}
